name: x_player_armor
description: High-performance modular player armor, shield defense, durability, and damage mitigation system attaching visual entities directly to skeletal bones.

scripts.i18n:extract: xgettext -L lua -kS -kPS:1,2 -kcore.translate:1c,2 -kcore.translate_n:1c,2,3 --from-code=UTF-8 --package-name=x_player_armor -o locale/x_player_armor.pot init.lua api.lua modules/*.lua modules/compat/*.lua
scripts.i18n:update: npm run i18n:extract && for f in locale/*.po; do [ -f "$f" ] && msgmerge -U --backup=none "$f" locale/x_player_armor.pot; done
scripts.i18n:check: for f in locale/*.po; do [ -f "$f" ] && msgfmt -c -v -o /dev/null "$f"; done
scripts.i18n: npm run i18n:update && npm run i18n:check

author: SaKeL
